title: XRD Analyzer: desktop and command-line analysis of 1D θ–2θ X-ray diffraction patterns
description: XRD Analyzer is an open-source desktop (PySide6) and command-line program for 1D θ–2θ X-ray diffraction patterns. It provides text import with explicit confirmation of the axis quantity and units; duplicate handling, measured-background subtraction with variance propagation, Kα2 stripping or Kα1/Kα2 doublet fitting; SNIP, asymmetric-least-squares, polynomial and peak-masked Whittaker baselines for separating amorphous contributions; peak detection and pseudo-Voigt/Voigt fitting with covariance-based uncertainties and convergence/identifiability flags; Bragg d-spacings; Scherrer and Williamson–Hall crystallite-size and microstrain analysis that is computed only when its inputs (shape factor, instrumental broadening, sufficient peaks) are valid; position-only phase-candidate comparison; and CSV, JSON, PNG, SVG, HTML and PDF reports with full provenance. Installers for Windows, macOS and Linux include a built-in self-test against synthetic ground-truth patterns.
